shortDescription: MAJOR INCIDENT – Regional network outage, NYC-ISP-01 circuit (5 stores)
description: ISP circuit NYC-ISP-01 down. Stores #322, #318, #327, #331, #340 affected. Raised by Stitch after regional health check.

timeline.author: Stitch (virtual agent)
timeline.text: Major incident raised: 5 NYC stores DOWN on circuit NYC-ISP-01. Child incidents linked.

timeline.author: Network Operations
timeline.text: ISP confirmed a fibre cut. Engineer dispatched, ETA 14:30. Stores with LTE backup: switch the router to LTE mode.
